purpose: Compare Tactical improvements against unchanged Casual under selectable-corner rules.
timeBasis: Fixed atomic-action budget; not timed 10-minute matches.
actualRules: All transitions use the same immutable shared rules module. Legacy AI tail spliced onto the shared rules prefix with corner ranking/successor compatibility; its old heuristics/search remain unchanged.
cornerSelection: For this comparison only, both Tactical policies and Casual use the same shared Casual corner selector in real play. This removes new selector-policy differences as a confound.
c2DifferenceFromC1: Public chance probabilities and goal value remain unchanged. Controlled possession, loose-ball race and keeper position utility scaled by 0.35; pending corner gets owned restart value. A normalization hardening for malformed corner saves differs in the C2 module, but normalizeGame is never called by this match harness or internal policy search.
heldout: C2 frozen before any second-seed outcomes were inspected. Two incomplete C1 second-seed workers were interrupted after progress-only output; no completed heldout C1 games were discarded or used for tuning.
c1Stopping: C1 capped at four complete balanced development games after initial exploratory comparison; fourth game restarted alone when stopping the worker pool. Three completed games preserved. No partial game counted as a result.
validation: Every initial and resulting state checked for roster IDs/count, positions, legal square eligibility, carrier consistency, dismissal/card persistence, min-player forfeit, pass-and-run metadata, and pending corner eligibility.
xG: Resolved opponent-goal attempt probability after actual keeper reaction; own-goal attempts counted separately.
limitations: Small deterministic sample; outcomes within a seed are correlated.
Fixed action budget does not map directly to UI match scores or equal ordinary rounds.
Thinking cost measured under varying worker contention; descriptive, not a clean single-core speed benchmark.
No heldout tuning or additional seeds after selection.
